name: Ikusa Megami 2 ~Ushinawareshi Kioku e no Chinkonka~
original_name: 戦女神２ ～失われし記憶への鎮魂歌～
source:
Celica has finished his mission of finding Princess Latina in the Kadora Mines around the town of Milphe, where he accidentally bought Saria, a slave girl, and made her his forth Apostle.

Six months later, in his mansion in Rewinia, he was awakened by a strange sound of ringing bells, which no one else had heard. This day he had an audience with Water Miko, who sent him on the another task - a research group from Rewinia went missing while performing a scheduled work in the dungeon where one of the legendary Seven Majins was sealed.

Celica could not imagine that this simple mission is just the first step that eventually will lead him to his forgotten memories and make him face his past.
translation:
赛利卡已经完成了在米鲁费镇附近的卡多拉矿山寻找拉提娜公主的任务。任务期间，他偶然买下奴隶少女萨莉亚，并让她成为自己的第四使徒。

六个月后，身在雷维尼亚宅邸的赛利卡被一阵奇异的铃声唤醒，但其他人谁也没有听见。这一天，他获水之巫女召见，并接到另一项任务：雷维尼亚的一支调查队在按计划探索某座地下迷宫时失踪，而那里封印着传说中的七魔神之一。

赛利卡无从想象，这项看似简单的任务只是第一步，最终将引领他找回遗失的记忆，并直面自己的过去。
